Intel (INTC) Shareholder Ronna Sue Cohen Has Lowered Its Holding; Facebook (FB) Market Valuation Declined While Perella Weinberg Partners Capital Management LP Has Cut Stake
June 29, 2018 - By Ellis Scott
Daniel Arbess decreased its stake in Facebook Inc (FB) by 50.32% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Perella Weinberg Partners Capital Management Lp sold 21,482 shares as the company’s stock declined 0.01% with the market. The hedge fund run by Daniel Arbess held 21,211 shares of the technology company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $3.39M, down from 42,693 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Perella Weinberg Partners Capital Management Lp who had been investing in Facebook Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $568.01B market cap company. The stock increased 0.20% or $0.39 during the last trading session, reaching $196.23. About 17.23 million shares traded. Facebook, Inc. (NASDAQ:FB) has risen 21.69% since June 29, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.12% the S&P500.
